- **Americano** (*contains alcohol*). Campari (1 oz) and Sweet Vermouth (1 oz red) with lemon and orange peel twists. It keeps the Campari but has no gin.

If you want to keep the Negroni style without the bitter edge, I'd start with the **Lone Tree Cocktail**. Enjoy responsibly!
